basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/RedRays%20SAP%20Security%20Findings/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. Bring RedRays SAP security findings into Microsoft Sentinel. Review vulnerability assessments, ABAP code findings, BTP security, segregation of duties, profile parameter checks and password security in one workbook, with analytics rules for findings that need attention. RedRays sends data on a schedule you choose through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API and stays in your existing on-premises or cloud environment. This connector does not collect SAP Security Audit Log events or populate ABAPAuditLog. You need a RedRays license with Microsoft Sentinel integration. Azure ingestion and retention charges apply. **Data Connectors:** 1, **Workbooks:** 1, **Analytic Rules:** 7 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This Solution installs the data connector for RedRays SAP Security Findings. You can get RedRays SAP Security Findings custom log data in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. After installing the solution, configure and enable this data connector by following guidance in Manage solution view.

options.text: This solution installs workbook(s) to help you gain insights into the telemetry collected in Microsoft Sentinel. After installing the solution, start using the workbook in Manage solution view.
Review SAP security findings, scan coverage and scheduled export health.
Choose from seven analytics rule templates. Review your initial findings, then create and enable the rules you need. Installing the solution does not enable any rules.

Alerts on new or materially changed, actionable SAP vulnerabilities from RedRays. Only High or Critical findings are selected. Initial findings raise alerts only if you enable baseline alerting in RedRays. Records outside the one-day query window do not trigger this rule.

Alerts on new or materially changed, actionable ABAP code findings from RedRays. Only High or Critical findings are selected. Initial findings raise alerts only if you enable baseline alerting in RedRays. Records outside the one-day query window do not trigger this rule.

Alerts on new or materially changed, actionable BTP security findings from RedRays. Only High or Critical findings are selected. Initial findings raise alerts only if you enable baseline alerting in RedRays. Records outside the one-day query window do not trigger this rule.

Alerts on new or materially changed, actionable segregation of duties findings from RedRays. Only High or Critical findings are selected. Initial findings raise alerts only if you enable baseline alerting in RedRays. Records outside the one-day query window do not trigger this rule.

Alerts on new or materially changed, actionable profile parameter checks from RedRays. Checks marked VULNERABLE raise Medium severity alerts under the integration's policy. Initial findings raise alerts only if you enable baseline alerting in RedRays. Records outside the one-day query window do not trigger this rule.

Alerts on new or materially changed, actionable password security findings from RedRays. Only High or Critical findings are selected. Initial findings raise alerts only if you enable baseline alerting in RedRays. Records outside the one-day query window do not trigger this rule.

Alerts when a previously connected RedRays instance stops sending export heartbeats. Set the threshold above your export interval and expected ingestion delay. The rule needs a previous heartbeat within its one-day query window.
